title: Constant realization preserves flat modules
statement: Let C be any small site with topology J [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], let R be a commutative ring in the coefficient universe, and let M be a flat R-module. The actual constant module realization c_R(M) [def-sfb-site-derived-constant-module-functor] is a flat module sheaf over the constant ring sheaf, in the sense of [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. No terminal object or enough-points assumption is required.

source.place: Tag 03ET, local equational criterion; algebra.tex Tag 08FC, equational criterion for flat modules.

proof.text: For a finite relation among sections of c_R(M), local surjectivity of ring and module sheafification lifts its finitely many coefficients and sections on a common covering. Local injectivity refines this cover so that the relation holds in M.

Use the ordinary module equational criterion to factor the relation through finitely many elements, with zero coefficient relations. Apply the semilinear module and ring sheafification units to these equations. The local relation criterion for module sheaves then proves flatness.

    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    (R : Type (max u v)) [CommRing R] (M : ModuleCat.{max u v} R)
    (hM : Module.Flat R M) :
    SheafOfModules.IsFlatOnSite.{u, v, max u v, max u v}
      (J := J) (R := realizationRing J R)
      ((commutativeSiteConstantModuleFunctor J R).obj M)
